data.name: WonderLang Mandarin Chinese
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to WonderLang Mandarin Chinese, where mastering Chinese becomes an engaging RPG journey. Immerse yourself in captivating quests, interactive dialogues, and fun puzzles designed to make language learning seamless and enjoyable.

This page is for the Chinese-learning version of WonderLang, focusing on standard Mandarin Chinese.

Learn Chinese from the following base (starting) languages: English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Korean, Chinese, Japanese, Dutch, Indonesian, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, and Arabic.

Other WonderLang versions are also available so you can learn French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Italian, Korean, Japanese, and Chinese. English is coming in February 2026. There is also a WonderLang Polyglot edition that gives you access to all languages, including future releases in a single purchase.

WonderLang weaves language into the core of its adventure and narrative. Get immersed in WonderLang as you Explore, Fight, Converse, and Investigate using your target language. Every quest and interaction becomes meaningful practice.

More affordable, more engaging, and way more fun than any subscription-based language learning app!

WonderLang is designed for beginner language learners, allowing you to dive into the game without any prior knowledge of Chinese. While the game does not aim to fully replace traditional language courses, it provides an immersive and enjoyable way to practice a new language gradually as you play.

Key Features

Immersive Chinese Learning

  • Learn practical Mandarin Chinese through every conversation, quest, and puzzle.

  • More than 45 hours of combined learning and gameplay.

  • 3 Modes to adapt the difficulty for very beginners, HSK 1, and HSK 2 level learners.

Skippable Pinyin Module and Smart Input Support

  • Start with a dedicated pinyin module that teaches pronunciation, and tones step by step. You can play it at your own pace or skip it entirely if you already know pinyin.

  • Choose between different input modes: type Chinese using pinyin input, or select characters directly for precise answers and exercises.

Flexible Reading Modes and Pinyin Support

  • Pick between three character learning modes: pinyin only (no hanzi), top 110 hanzi (learn the most common characters while keeping the rest in pinyin), or full hanzi.

  • Enable an option to display pinyin above hanzi. Pinyin shows pronunciation and tones, making it easier to read and learn new words.

  • Practice drawing hanzi directly on your screen to internalize stroke order and improve writing memory.

Engaging Storyline

  • Follow the journey of a young hero who must learn Chinese to lift a magical curse from their brother.

  • Explore vibrant towns, uncover secrets, and build friendships by interacting with over 60 unique NPCs.

Learning as a Gameplay Mechanic

  • Solve puzzles and complete quests by forming sentences and understanding dialogues.

  • Practice pronunciation and tones with speech recognition challenges.

  • Use in-game tools such as a dictionary, tone hints, and contextual help to support your learning.

Spaced Repetition Combat Challenges

  • Engage in language-based combat to reinforce vocabulary, tones, and grammar through repeated exposure.

  • Combat challenges are designed using the spaced repetition principle to boost long term retention and keep your skills sharp.

Real World Context Practice

  • Apply your Chinese skills in everyday scenarios such as ordering food, shopping, or making appointments.

  • Experience practical vocabulary and grammar in real world inspired contexts to enhance your confidence and fluency.

Customizable Learning Experience

  • Customize your learning journey with difficulty settings that make the experience more relaxed or more challenging.

  • Set daily goals and earn rewards for reaching them, helping you build a consistent learning routine.

Rich Interactive World

  • Explore diverse locations, each introducing specific Chinese vocabulary, tones, and grammar patterns.

  • Participate in mini games like crosswords, memory games, tone challenges, and character puzzles to diversify your learning experience.

WonderLang can be played with a mouse and keyboard, mouse only, or keyboard only.

It also plays great on the Steam Deck with an official control layout.

data.short_description: Learn Mandarin Chinese through immersive quests, interactive dialogues, and spaced repetition combat challenges. Help a young hero lift a magical curse by mastering Chinese. Customize your learning experience and explore a world filled with unique characters. Start your learning journey today!
data.supported_languages:
English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Dutch, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese*, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support

Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft Windows® 8.1/10/11 (64bit)
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Required
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display
